question: Is the SIMULATED hybrid (SAM3 mask on every 4th frame, EdgeTAM between, re-initialised from SAM3's mask) non-inferior to SAM3 f16 on DAVIS-2017 val under the AC15 protocol? The simulation takes keyframe masks from SAM3's full-sequence tracker, so it is an UPPER BOUND for a real hybrid that runs SAM3 on keyframes only.
data: DAVIS-2017 val, 30 sequences, 480p; first-frame GT box + one interior point per object (AC15 protocol)
unit: sequence: J&F averaged over frames 1..T-1, then over objects (as AC15; this differs from the official DAVIS per-object pooling)
primary_contrast: d_i = JF_hybrid_k4,i - JF_sam3_f16,i, paired by sequence
margin_provenance: equals AC15's jf_margin (A8), fixed before this analysis and not tuned to the hybrid
test: intersection-union: one-sided paired t non-inferiority (H0: mean(d) <= -margin, df = n-1) AND lower end of the BCa 90% two-sided CI (= 95% one-sided; 10000 resamples, seed 20261019) of mean(d) > -margin. Both required; disagreement = not non-inferior. If sd(d) = 0 the t statistic is +/-inf by the sign of mean+margin.

type_I_check.method: simulation, normal d with sd 0.032, n 30, 400 replicates, BCa 1500 resamples

baseline: SAM3 f16 JF per sequence from evidence/<baseline_run>/sam3 (AC15). Hash recipe: sha256 of json.dumps({sequence: JF}, sort_keys=True). The SAM3 rerun that produces the keyframe masks must reproduce each value within baseline_tolerance; this also proves the metric code is unchanged since AC15 (sam3_eval.py was edited after AC15 for per-frame output and mask saving).

run_validity.invalid_run: a SAM3 baseline failure after retries, or a baseline that is not reproduced, aborts the run (nothing is scored; it is not a fail of the hybrid). After an abort a rerun is allowed only with the cause documented in attempts.jsonl and the same frozen files; the abort stays in the log.
run_validity.infrastructure_failure: non-zero exit or timeout (900 s per EdgeTAM segment) of a binary: identical retry up to 2 times, every attempt logged; then the hybrid is scored JF=0 for that sequence (conservative). Any other Python exception aborts the run. If the machine sleeps or a process is killed the run is resumed with the same command; sequences already written are kept and the log shows it.
run_validity.reuse: run refuses to start if the output directory holds results without an attempts.jsonl; deleting a result to re-roll it is a deviation and is recorded as one

no_peeking: run prints progress only; analyse runs once after all 30 sequences are written (it refuses to run twice); n is fixed at 30, no early stopping and no stopping rule; no change to K, prompts, models, binaries, code or environment after the lock
deviation_protocol: any deviation from this rule is reported with the original verdict; the original rule's verdict is the one that stands; exclusions: none
run_conditions: quiet machine (no other heavy jobs), CLI threads 8, no fixed random seeds are used by the pipeline (it is deterministic); hardware and OS build are recorded in env.json
if_pass: licenses stage 2 only: implement the hybrid in the pipeline, then (a) re-test the REAL implementation's J&F against the same margin on data chosen and registered beforehand, (b) measure end-to-end speed (>= 1.25x, quiet machine) and memory, (c) measure the downstream effect on the static map. It does not adopt the hybrid by itself.
if_fail: a fail of the simulated upper bound is evidence against the hybrid on DAVIS; K and the method are not retuned on val; a retry needs data not used for selection. (A pass of the upper bound does not show the real hybrid passes; a fail of the real hybrid in stage 2 would be a separate finding.)
not_claimed: DAVIS J&F non-inferiority says nothing about the downstream static-map effect or about ATAS-domain footage

power.method: noncentral t, one-sided alpha 0.05 (t test alone; the both-required test is 1-2 points lower)
power.note: point estimates from the selection data (20 DAVIS train sequences; the sd rests on n=20).

selection_data.outlier_dependence: drift-turn (+0.116 over SAM3) lifts K=4's mean from -0.0127 to -0.0062; without it the sd is 0.014; the headroom to -0.02 rests on one recovered SAM3 failure; the estimate is subject to a winner's curse

order_of_events: SAM3 f16 and f32 per-sequence J&F on val (mean 0.882; AC15 floor 0.892 not met) were produced and seen before this rule (AC15). EdgeTAM and the hybrid have never been run on val. K, hand-off vs box re-prompt and the margin were fixed on train.
limits_stated_in_advance: simulation: keyframe masks come from SAM3's full-sequence tracker, so the result is an upper bound for a hybrid that runs SAM3 on keyframes only

contamination: EdgeTAM trained on DAVIS (arXiv 2501.07256 Sec 4.1); SAM3's media pool lists DAVIS2017 (arXiv 2511.16719 Table 25, column inferred); which DAVIS split each saw is not stated, so val is not known to be clean for either model
SAM3 weights are a third-party ggml conversion; identity with facebook/sam3 is unverified

mask hand-off: logits +-6, obj_score 10, zero object pointer, frame index clamp; not verified against EdgeTAM's reference mask-prompt path (SAM2 uses +-10 and a decoder-derived pointer); likely a small effect
val is consumed by this test whether it passes or fails
